title: Sambar
subtitle: A hearty South Indian toor dal and vegetable stew with tamarind and sambar powder — for idli, dosa or rice.
protein: ~7–9g protein per adult serving — from toor dal

method.title: Tamarind pulp and dal
items: Soak {@tamarind} in {@water-tamarind} for 20–30 min
Once soft, squeeze it in the water; discard the strained tamarind and keep the pulp aside
Rinse {@toor} a couple of times; drain
Add {@toor|the rinsed dal} to a 3-litre pressure cooker with {@turmeric:dal} and {@water-dal}; mix
Pressure cook 7–8 whistles on medium heat (Instant Pot: high pressure 10 min, natural release)
When the pressure settles on its own, open and check the dal is completely mushy; mash it with a whisk, cover and keep aside

method.title: Cook the vegetables
items: While the dal cooks, prep the veg: rinse, peel and chop
Put {@vegetables}, {@drumsticks}, {@pumpkin} and {@tomato} in a pot, with {@potato:toddler|her potato cubes}
Sprinkle {@turmeric:veg} and {@salt}; add {@water-veg} and stir
Cook on medium-low to medium, checking now and then, until the vegetables are almost done — don't overcook them

method.label: Toddler — pull her portion here (before sambar powder and chili)
items: Scoop out all of her potato and {=2–3 tbsp} of the soft vegetables — no drumstick, it's too fibrous
Add {=2 tbsp} of the mashed dal and mash everything together until soft
Stir in {@ghee-toddler:toddler}

method.title: Make the sambar
items: Add {@tamarind|the tamarind pulp}, {@sambar-powder} and {@kashmiri-chili} to the vegetables; mix well
Add {@toor|the mashed dal}; mix again very well
Simmer on medium-low until the sambar comes to a boil
When a frothy layer appears on top, switch off the heat; cover and set aside

method.title: Temper and finish
items: Heat {@sesame-oil} in a small pan; add {@mustard} and let them splutter
Add {@methi-seeds}, {@red-chilies} and {@curry-leaves}; fry until the chilies darken a shade
Add {@hing}; stir 2 seconds and pour the tempering over the sambar; cover 5 min
Garnish with {@coriander}; serve with rice, idli, dosa or medu vada
Keeps 3 days refrigerated; reheat with a splash of water

method.label: Tip
method.text: Pearl onions → extra pumpkin, for the same soft sweetness, plus hing in the tempering. The original's potato now cooks only for the toddler. Use the site's own sambar powder recipe — store sambar powders often aren't Jain. Best with the Instant Pot or pressure cooker for the dal (hands-off, fully mushy) while the vegetables cook on the stove.
